source_refinement: Terrain-first massing is not terrain acceptance: resolve drainage, incised paths, retaining edges, foundation contacts and every grade before detailed structures.
Check floor/wall/roof joins, upper-deck undersides and corners with adjacent lights toggled; log every discovered failure.
Engineer stairs, landings, openings, guards, door swings and two exits before collision/navigation approval.
Inspect each model purpose, scale, UVs and true support surface before placing furniture or clutter.
Historic coastal-site functional reference only; original fictional battery with removed/inert equipment.
Roof cover over lower rooms requires full sealed slabs and stair voids; grade reservations are not accepted routes.
